purpose: Test whether a calibration-frozen, reference-free registry refinement produces terminal root-level active-selection harm on fresh open-ended QA and translation tasks while changing at most one percent of a parent's bounded utility.

provenance_and_non_cherry_picking.why_separate: Step 87A failed structurally because its 18 frozen MMLU subjects do not exist in HELM-Lite v1.0.0. Step 87A remains a no-go and is not amended.
provenance_and_non_cherry_picking.information_used_to_choose_step87b: Only GCS object-prefix metadata, model/file availability, scenario names, and an exact local project-name search. No Step 87B prompt, prediction, per-instance statistic, reference, aggregate score, selector outcome, or attack outcome was downloaded or inspected.
provenance_and_non_cherry_picking.freshness: Exact scenario-name search returned no pre-Step-87B project artifact for all eight scenarios.
provenance_and_non_cherry_picking.coverage_reason: The eight untouched complete-roster scenarios exhaust the fresh non-LegalBench HELM-Lite v1.0.0 scenarios left after excluding all tasks previously analyzed by this project; they add open-ended reading comprehension, knowledge QA, and five translation language pairs.
provenance_and_non_cherry_picking.forbidden_replacement: No frozen scenario may be replaced after this file is locked, including after a schema failure or unfavorable result.

public_source.response_canonicalization: Use stripped mapped_output when non-null, otherwise stripped predicted_text; preserve the full Unicode string and prefix an actually empty result with EMPTY:.

utility_rule.selection: For each scenario, choose the first listed key present for every example of every frozen model. No observed attack effect enters metric selection.
utility_rule.range: Every recorded per-instance utility must lie in [0,1].
utility_rule.alias_changed_coordinate_utility: The wrapper emits a task- and alias-specific opaque abstention token. Its utility is fixed at zero only after an integrity check that the alphanumeric token is absent from every sealed reference; otherwise the whole scenario fails structurally rather than being repaired.
utility_rule.alias_unchanged_coordinate_utility: Inherit the selected parent's recorded utility exactly.

required: All 31 frozen models have the same unique instance IDs.
The scenario contains at least 200 examples so both halves contain at least 100.
One frozen ordered metric key is present for every model-example pair and all values lie in [0,1].
Every instance contains at least one reference string.
Every opaque abstention token is alphanumerically absent from every reference string.
structural_eligibility.failure_policy: Mark that frozen scenario structurally failed, report it, and do not replace it. A global separation failure forces NO_TERMINAL_PROMOTION.

split_and_separation.rule: For each scenario, sort examples by SHA-256 of compact JSON [manifest_id, split, task, public instance ID]. The first floor(N/2) form labeled calibration and the remainder form sealed holdout.
split_and_separation.calibration: May include all candidate responses, selected per-instance utilities, prompts, and references.
split_and_separation.blind_parent_input: One file per candidate and task containing only IDs, prompts, and that parent's output.
split_and_separation.stage_a: Selects all attack hyperparameters from calibration, then opens only the selected parent's blind holdout file. It may not read holdout references, peer outputs, utilities, pools, or selector state.
split_and_separation.stage_b: May open the sealed holdout package only after the frozen attack rows and execution lock are hashed.

selector_protocol.selector: Equation-faithful, canonical-order Select-LLM V2 exact-response backend used by the manuscript's Step 80 transfer.
selector_protocol.candidate_tie_rule: Canonical response-vector hash followed by accountable root ID and label hash; selected root is the minimum canonical root ID among exact score ties.
selector_protocol.query_tie_rule: Minimum global query ID among exact acquisition minima.
selector_protocol.temperature_selection: Separately for each budget, choose the temperature minimizing clean calibration mean cumulative root regret over 200 frozen pools; ties choose the smaller temperature.

attack_protocol.distance_realization: max(1, floor(fraction * split_size)) changed coordinates per alias.
attack_protocol.quality_bound: Because utilities are bounded in [0,1] and only changed coordinates are assigned zero, each alias can lose at most its declared distance fraction in mean utility and can never improve through the intervention.
attack_protocol.error_learner: Five-fold out-of-fold TF-IDF bigram ridge regression predicts continuous calibration error 1-utility from prompt and parent output; refit on all calibration data for blind holdout scoring.
attack_protocol.prediction_only_target_screen: Before attacked calibration scoring, retain the five parent roots with greatest exact-clone first-query change fraction on calibration responses and pools; ties use model name.
attack_protocol.replacement: At a selected coordinate, emit ZZZQXVSTEP87B plus task digest plus alias index. The builder derives it without references or peer responses.
attack_protocol.calibration_selection: Across the five screened parents, three support policies, two distances, and three budgets, maximize mean adaptive-minus-fixed terminal root-regret effect; ties maximize active terminal root harm, then adaptive-minus-fixed cumulative root harm, then choose smaller distance, budget, parent index, and policy name.

statistics_and_controls.multiplicity_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg across all eight frozen scenarios, separately for active terminal root harm and adaptive-minus-fixed terminal root harm.
statistics_and_controls.fixed_query_control: Clean and refined scenarios receive byte-identical registry-independent query matrices. Since every alias utility is coordinate-wise no greater than its retained parent and the original parent remains, fixed-query root selections are expected to be identical and are verified rather than assumed.

scenario_pass_gate.quality: Every alias has holdout mean utility gap in [-0.01,0] and exact declared response distance at most 0.01.
scenario_pass_gate.integrity: Four distinct non-parent response hashes; no forbidden holdout input; opaque token absent from references; fixed-query matrices byte-identical.
scenario_pass_gate.active_terminal_root_harm: Paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and one-sided sign-flip BH q < 0.05.
scenario_pass_gate.adaptive_terminal_excess: Per-pool active terminal delta minus fixed-query terminal delta has paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and one-sided sign-flip BH q < 0.05.
scenario_pass_gate.fixed_query_boundary: The fixed-query terminal effect is always reported; any nonzero effect prevents an exact-mediation claim even if the scenario otherwise passes.

overall_decision.PROMOTE_REFERENCE_FREE_TERMINAL_BRIDGE: At least two of eight frozen scenarios pass every scenario gate and no global separation/integrity gate fails.
overall_decision.NARROW_TERMINAL_BRIDGE: Exactly one scenario passes every scenario gate and no global separation/integrity gate fails.
overall_decision.NO_TERMINAL_PROMOTION: No scenario passes or a global separation/integrity gate fails.

forbidden_rescues: No scenario, model roster, target-screen size, policy, distance, budget, temperature, seed, utility key order, statistic, or gate may change after the execution lock.
No holdout-better configuration may replace the calibration-selected configuration.
No structurally failed scenario may be replaced.
Cumulative harm alone cannot satisfy the terminal bridge.
Every unfavorable or null frozen scenario remains in the report and any paper discussion.
